notes.title: Interstellar Sentinel 2 – Build 0.6.1 Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Interstellar Sentinel 2 – Build 0.6.1 Notes[/b][/h1][p]First off, thank you to everyone jumping into playtesting and giving feedback. Your eyes and reactions are making this game tighter every step of the way. Here’s what’s locked in for 0.6.1:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="KrZGyFUA7UE;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Boss Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Quantint[/b]. Homing bullets now start a little earlier for better pacing. Homing kunai energy daggers increased slightly in size (matched to Peace Keeper drones). Chain combo maintainer blood effect adjusted so it no longer obscures the player. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Heart Boss[/b]. Plasma wave attack begins earlier. Slight health boost added. Fixed late music change issue. Animated warning indicators added for the first two phases. Stopping music on death now transitions properly into Shmup Shop music. [/p][/*][*][p][b]DTCD Boss[/b]. Faster vertical Robonoid string speeds on final approach. Fixed pre-boss music change. Phase 2 building spawns now include extended caution signs to left and right. Added new animation for the Heart phase.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemy & Encounter Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Robonoids[/b]. Early backward large Robonoid wave timing tightened so they move in quicker. Adjusted backward large Robonoid laser enemy spawn (lowered and delayed slightly). Double large Robonoid minigun variant now has extended spawn warnings and adjusted positioning. These spawns now come after killing the double PTPD cruisers. Vertical waves in the Laser Grid, Space Rip Field Generator section are now better timed. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minirobonoids[/b]. Explosion death sound effect swapped out. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Spider Train Barrier[/b]. Increased health. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Surge Waves[/b]. First two surge waves made slightly harder to activate. Surge waves spawn when all enemies before a Space Ripper portal are destroyed, triggering a Space Rip Field Generator. The Generator then brings in the extra surge enemies for skilled players to challenge. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Rewards[/b]. Moved further right to daisy chain supers [/p][/*][*][p][b]Star Gems[/b]. Reduced opacity for cleaner visuals.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visual & Audio Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Building Storm VFX[/b]. Less shiny particle diarrhea. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Lens Flares[/b]. Fixed extra glow appearing during final boss fight. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine Thrusters[/b]. Added subtle thruster particles to the opening scene in Level 1. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Laser Towers[/b]. Adjusted rotator bullet size and time between waves. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Loki Dialogue[/b]. Lowered volume (audio still temp). Fixed Loki spawn issue. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Focus Attack Slash[/b]. Increased volume. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Audio Cue[/b] on bullet cancel. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Surge Trophy[/b]. Added new DBK announcer voice line.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Systems & Performance[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Player Shield[/b]. Now provides 2 HP instead of 1 HP. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto Weapon Upgrade System[/b]. Fixed system giving upgrades during the rank screen sequence. Removed audio cue when the item applies. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance & Memory[/b]. Optimizations across the board. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This build keeps us pushing toward tighter, fairer fights and more polish across the experience. Thanks again for putting in time on the sticks and catching details with us. Keep the feedback flowing, and we’ll keep leveling this up.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Note[/b]: Check the bottom left screen version number in the tutorial level to confirm you have the latest version. If you do not have the latest version:[/p][list][*][p]Right click on IS2 in your Steam library [/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Properties > Installed Files [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Click on [b]Verify integrity of game files[/b] to force the update [/p][/*][/list][p]If you would like to join the playtesting reach out to me and @Elleroch to get a Steam key.[/p][p]This build update would not be what it is without your playtesting. Thank you![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: ✨ Interstellar Sentinel 2 – Surge & Balance Update

starting lives to [b]30[/b] (for Easy difficulty testing, reduces continue screen churn).[/p][/*][*][p]Shield power-up: increased attraction radius to make it easier to grab under duress.[/p][/*][*][p]Riot Shield Mechs:[/p][list][*][p]Nerfed overall health.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where shield could be left behind if the mech was killed under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Large Robonoid Minigunner: added a little more time between bullet waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Materializer Tanks: increased HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Materializer Cannon: added more cannon shot strings and increased shot speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Highness & Royale Highness scores.[/p][/*][*][p]Astral Projection:[/p][list][*][p]Buffed melee damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted damage curves and tick rate for consistency.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rapid Shot: increased starting spread size and spread starting streams to 3, added wider spread shot streams on upgrades, adjusted damage curves for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Overcharge Swords:[/p][list][*][p]Added bullet impact sparks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Enemies & Bosses[/h2][list][*][p]Large Robonoids:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing teleportation VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]First enemy surge: bring forward more, update teleport VFX/timing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]DTCD Boss:[/p][list][*][p]Intro: cut music, add screen shake during boss construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Robo Kensis building section: add hologram warnings for reverse/top/bottom buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Head phase 2: make a bigger moment with large outward particle explosion that then reverses into head reconstruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed laser tower section stuck bug.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Laser Towers:[/p][list][*][p]From top: added a warning indicator before appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser tower field: base parts are now the criteria for triggering the enemy surge condition.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Space Ripper Enemy Surge Wave: (4 large Robonoids): add teleportation and/or back warning sign, offset entrance further back.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted health for both level 1 bosses[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Visual & Effects[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed laser grids / Robonoid vertical waves spawning too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel Tower: adjusted Z-sorting of H-building for enemy surge Materializer Tank.[/p][/*][*][p]Added boss damage chain combo maintainer.[/p][/*][*][p]Added chain combo maintainer for bosses in general.[/p][/*][*][p]DTCD Boss destruction: added music transition + explosion SFX for head/body destruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Lens flare polish pass in the city.[/p][/*][*][p]City build: adjusted top parallax speed (slowed).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]UI & Text[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed tutorial confirmation text: changed from “reverse shot” to [b]Back Shot[/b] (also updated frontend button mapping).[/p][/*][*][p]Backward shot: fixed text confirmation.[/p][/*][*][p]Double-check [b]Loki rank condition[/b] (validation pending).[/p][/*][*][p]Secret item: Moved the spawn to the lower third of the screen, moved the sparkle and AOE ring above the clouds. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Free 0.3.0 Demo Update - Secret Caravan Challenge Added
notes.content: [p]Thank you so much to all the Steam Next Fest players for checking out our game! Based on community playtesting, we've fixed a number of bugs, added a bit more polish, and added a secret bonus level for people chasing those high scores. [/p][p][/p][p]We're watching and listening, so don't hesitate to keep sharing your feedback and playtest videos. It's super fun to see the new strategies emerge.[/p]
